entities.summary: Katharine Cameron RWS RE was a Scottish artist, watercolourist, and printmaker, best known for her paintings and etchings of flowers. She was associated with the group of artists known as the Glasgow Girls. Katherine Cameron was a authors & novelists from Glasgow (1874-02-26, Glasgow–1965-08-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
